# Vendored license sources

This directory records the original public license and attribution files for the 13 locked packages whose package roots did not contain a root license file in the release inventory. `registry.json` maps every package and version to its files, public source URL, and SHA-256 digest.

`selectors@0.36.1` is MPL-2.0. Its original Cargo archive is retained at `sources/selectors-0.36.1.crate`; the archive digest matches the `selectors@0.36.1` checksum in the locked Cargo manifests. The full MPL-2.0 text is included beside it from Mozilla's public license source.

The UNIC packages include both declared dual-license texts and their `COPYRIGHT.md` attribution file. The inspected locked package roots and matching repository trees did not contain an additional NOTICE file for these 13 packages. This inventory is a release artifact record and does not make a general legal completeness claim.
